label: TP
reason: User-supplied parameter name flows directly into the format string argument via ArrayList manipulation (removing 'safe', keeping 'param'). The resulting string is passed to PrintWriter.format(), which interprets %n%s/%n%d specifiers from the user input, enabling arbitrary command execution/format string attacks. No sanitization occurs.

evidence.note: Parameter name extracted from request, added to list, sanitized list used to assign bar, then bar passed to format() sink allowing format string vulnerabilities.
